method: Spectral collocation of the dimensionless integro-differential relaxation equation dSigma/dtau = L[Sigma'''] (L = Cauchy-PV integral operator of the free-surface climb-dislocation kernel) in a basis phi_0=1-(1-Z)^(5/2), phi_j=Z(1-Z)^(5/2) T_{j-1}(2Z-1) that satisfies the boundary conditions and the exact crack-tip behavior; Gauss-Legendre PV quadrature after the smoothing substitution Z'=1-y^2; generalized eigendecomposition (scipy.linalg.eig) for lambda f = -L[f''']; steady state L[A]=1 solved with crack-singular basis R/sqrt(1-Z) giving K_inf = 1.1215223 sigma0 sqrt(pi h) (edge crack). Cross-checks: independent polynomial-basis eigensolver and direct time-domain integration reproduce lambda1 and the mode shape.
